name: FYIcons

source.exportMethod: Figma MCP exportAsync SVG_STRING, svgSimplifyStroke=false; foreground paint normalized to currentColor
source.scope: Complete Icons section snapshot. All 1052 eligible 16x16 exports verified against live SHA-256 checksums before foreground color normalization. Retained the prior 16x16 copy-sm source because its live component is 12x12. Excluded new 16x15 blueprint-grid. Masks and clip paths preserve Figma paint.

duplicatePolicy: Distinct icons with the same base name receive numeric suffixes to disambiguate the current inventory; suffixes may change when the inventory changes.
